The bounded typed implementation covers Material, Material:NoMass, Material:AirGap, Material:InfraredTransparent, WindowMaterial:Glazing:RefractionExtinctionMethod, WindowMaterial:Glazing:EquivalentLayer, WindowMaterial:Gas, WindowMaterial:Gap:EquivalentLayer, WindowMaterial:GasMixture, WindowMaterial:Shade, WindowMaterial:Shade:EquivalentLayer, and WindowMaterial:Drape:EquivalentLayer plus only the SpectralAverage branch of WindowMaterial:Glazing; unsupported optical modes explicitly fail closed. RefractionExtinction preserves its raw n/k inputs and EnergyPlus 26.1 formula/visible-back quirk. Equivalent-layer glazing preserves all 26 numeric inputs, six bounded Autocalculate states, source defaults, and the SpectralAverage-only contract without adding optical-sum validation absent from its source block; its ignored spectral-dataset string is type-checked but not retained. Ordinary Gas resolves Air, Argon, Krypton, and Xenon to exact built-in constants after type/schema checking supplied custom fields; Custom preserves the three A+B*T+C*T^2 coefficient sets, validates positive 300 K conductivity and source/schema bounds, derives nominal resistance, and intentionally retains numeric zero for a missing specific-heat ratio. Equivalent-layer Gap reuses those gas records with its schema-distinct uppercase gas enum and required Sealed, VentedIndoor, or VentedOutdoor mode, without inventing the schema note's unenforced Air-only relationship. GasMixture encodes a one-to-four active prefix of standard-only gases, validates the schema-required Gas 1/Gas 2 pairs even for count 1, preserves missing active optional Gas 3/4 fractions as zero, and allows duplicate species and non-unit sums without normalization; nominal resistance uses only the first gas at 300 K. MaterialFamily separates opaque, ordinary fenestration, and equivalent-layer consumers. Ordinary Construction rejects equivalent-layer glazing, gaps, shades, and drapes because only the still-deferred Construction:WindowEquivalentLayer may consume them, while the bounded ordinary-window subset accepts exactly Glass ((Gas\|GasMixture) Glass){0..3}. Arbitrary-run support assessment explicitly counts and run-blocks the complete typed RefractionExtinction, all four EquivalentLayer objects, Gas, GasMixture, and ordinary Shade before execution. Existing material_opaque_variants_001, window_glazing_spectral_average_001, and window_glazing_refraction_extinction_001 provide only their declared nonblocking static EIO evidence. window_glazing_equivalent_layer_001 adds bounded external diagnostic evidence for the dedicated 18-token EIO row, and window_material_gas_001 adds duplicate-aware ordinary-window gas-layer occurrence evidence with exact EnergyPlus 26.1 {:.3R} thickness serialization. window_material_gap_equivalent_layer_001 adds a clean nonblocking exact seven-occurrence fixture sequence across all five gas types and all three vent modes, with one reused Argon material and one unused Air definition excluded; material name, canonical gas/vent type, and source-formatted thickness are exact. EIO omits Custom coefficients/properties and nominal resistance. Its shared WindowMaterial:Gas header is exact and has zero data rows. The generic rows expose no mixture component count/species/fractions/order, nominal resistance, or occurrence/use/reuse status; two exact seven-layer WindowConstruction rows and host/window rows are oracle-only fixture locks.
